Callout.Name: Reported Truancy
Callout.Message: School reporting pupils off site during hours.
Callout.Advisory: Two pupils in a park, no offence reported.

Script.Line: It is a free period. Everybody in my year has a free period.
I am not even supposed to be in today.
You can ring the school. They will tell you.

Lines.Approach: Two of them in the park when they should be in a lesson. The school wants them brought back.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
